home.title: Admin Portal

system.title: System status
system.error: The status could not be read.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how the admin looks and which language it uses. The language is also saved on your account.

session.title: Session
session.description: A call through the gateway with your session cookie.
session.subject: Subject

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name and picture. They show in the header; you can change them without any permission.

search.label: Email
search.hint: Emails that start with this text
search.name: Name

new.title: Add user
new.description: The user gets a welcome email with a link to set their own password.
new.welcomeSent: A welcome email with a link to set the password was sent.
new.welcomeNote: A welcome email with a link to set the password (valid 7 days) is sent to the user. The account stays Pending until the password is set.

account.title: Account
account.pendingHint: The user has not set a password yet. The account becomes active when they do, through the link in the welcome email.

mfa.title: Multi-factor authentication
mfa.state: Server mode: {{mode}}. This user: {{enrolled}}, {{required}}, recovery codes left: {{left}}.
mfa.required: MFA is required for this user.
mfa.confirmReset: Reset MFA? The authenticator and the recovery codes are deleted.
mfa.hint: An admin cannot enroll an authenticator for a user: the user does it on their own device.

form.name: Name
form.localeHint: Language of the emails sent to the user.

avatar.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. It is cropped to a square and resized to {{side}}x{{side}} in your browser before it is saved.
avatar.failedAfterCreate: The picture could not be saved: upload it again.

error.type: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
error.size: The file is larger than 5 MB.
error.decode: The file could not be read as a picture.
error.encode: The picture could not be prepared.

roles.title: Roles & Permissions

new.title: New role
new.name: Name
new.permissionsHint: Separated by spaces or new lines, e.g. identity:user:read bill:*
new.pickHint: Tick the permissions the role gets.

perm.title: Permissions
perm.intro: The catalog of permissions that roles can be given. A permission in use by a role cannot be deleted.
perm.name: Permission
perm.nameHint: For example bill:invoice:read, or a wildcard such as bill:*.

form.addIntro: Give the role a name and tick what it allows.
form.nameFixed: The name of a role cannot be changed.
form.deleteHint: No user and no client holds this role, so it can be deleted.
form.heldBy: Held by {{count}} user(s) or client(s); take the role away from them first.

roles.searchHint: Name, description or a permission of the role

clients.title: Clients
clients.confirmRotate: Rotate the secret of {{id}}? The current secret stops working.

secret.title: Secret of {{id}}
secret.warning: Copy it now. It is shown once and cannot be read again; rotate the secret to get a new one.

form.addIntro: Register an application or a service that signs in through identity.
form.idFixed: The id of a client cannot be changed.
form.typeFixed: The type of a client cannot be changed.
form.rotateHint: Issues a new secret; the current one stops working at once.
form.enabledHint: Disable the client to stop it signing in or getting tokens. Only a disabled client can be deleted.
form.disabledHint: This client cannot sign in or get tokens. Enable it again, or delete it for good.
form.deleteWarning: Deleting {{id}} also removes its roles and exchange policies. This cannot be undone.
form.accessHint: Pick the grants this client may use. Scopes: leave empty for openid profile email offline_access.

grant.authorization_code: A person signs in in the browser (with PKCE for a public client).
grant.refresh_token: Gets a new token without signing in again.
grant.client_credentials: A service calls the API as itself, no person involved. Confidential clients only.
grant.token_exchange: Swaps a token for one for another service (the gateway does this).
grant.unknown: Not a grant identity knows; untick to remove it.

exchange.title: Exchange policies
exchange.intro: Token exchange is denied unless a policy allows the calling client to obtain a token for the audience.
exchange.confirmDelete: Delete the policy of {{client}} for {{audience}}? Exchanges stop working (deny by default).

form.addIntro: Allow a client to exchange a token for an audience.
form.keyFixed: The client and the audience of a policy cannot be changed.
form.audienceHint: The service the exchanged token is for, e.g. identity
form.depthHint: 1 to 5 levels of act (delegation) in the exchanged token
form.notFound: There is no policy of {{client}} for {{audience}}.
form.deleteHint: Exchanges of this client for this audience stop working (deny by default).
